title.zh: OpenAI 称其自主安全代理发现 948 个 Linux 内核漏洞
title.en: 【OpenAI 称 AI 发现 948 个 Linux 漏洞，行业观点认为去中心化有助于应对风险】

current_state.zh: OpenAI says its autonomous security agents identified 948 Linux kernel privilege-escalation vulnerabilities and generated working exploits plus candidate patches for about $1.21 million in API credits.
current_state.en: OpenAI says its autonomous security agents identified 948 Linux kernel privilege-escalation vulnerabilities and generated working exploits plus candidate patches for about $1.21 million in API credits.
